name: Enraged Sea Life
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-03: A Foot in the Door
description: A swarm of aggressive cuttlefish, octopuses, devil rays, and countless other species of sea life bite and bludgeon Timonithaea's enemies.
disable: DC 23 Thievery (trained) to remove the crown from the altar while avoiding being bitten by the swarming sea life; or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to disable the crown's enchantment, breaking Timonithaea's control over the sea creatures.
routine: (one action) The sea creatures attack, dealing (1d8+3) Bludgeoning Damage] damage to each creature hostile to Timonithaea within the temple (Basic DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Aquatic Onslaught
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The PCs enter the main temple chamber

Effect The chamber fills with sea creatures, then rolls initiative.
